info.title: MCQ Online Test Platform API
info.description:
Role-based REST API for the MCQ Online Test Platform: examiners manage a
question bank and review results, while examinees take a 50-question
multiple-choice test.

## Roles

| Role | How authenticated | Capabilities |
|------|-------------------|--------------|
| **Examinee** | `POST /auth/examinee/entry` (PRN + name) | Take the test, review answers, export own data |
| **Examiner** | `POST /auth/examiner/login` (username + password) | Manage questions, view session results, read settings |
| **Admin examiner** | Examiner login with admin flag | Additionally create examiners, update settings, request GDPR erasure |

## Authentication

Authentication uses an **opaque server-side session** stored in Redis and
delivered via an HttpOnly `session_id` cookie (path `/api/v1`,
`SameSite=strict`). There are no bearer tokens. Cookies are set by the login
and entry endpoints and cleared by `POST /auth/logout`.

## CSRF protection

All mutating endpoints (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) on authenticated routes
require the `X-CSRF-Token` header. The session-bound token is returned by
`GET /auth/me`; a pre-login token for the login forms is available from
`GET /auth/csrf`.

## Response conventions

- **Success** responses wrap the payload in an envelope:
  `{ "data": ..., "meta": { "request_id": "..." } }`.
- **Errors** are returned as RFC 7807 problem details with content type
  `application/problem+json` (see the `ProblemDetails` schema). Validation
  failures return **400** with a field-level `errors` array.
- Every response carries an `X-Request-Id` header that matches
  `meta.request_id`, for log correlation.
- File downloads (data export, CSV export) bypass the envelope and return
  raw content with a `Content-Disposition: attachment` header.

get.description:
Liveness probe — returns 200 as long as the process is running.

Performs no external dependency checks; use `/ready` for that.

schema.title: Response Health Api V1 Health Get

get.description:
Readiness probe — verifies PostgreSQL and Redis connectivity.

Returns **503** with per-dependency flags when any check fails, so
orchestrators can stop routing traffic to this instance.

schema.title: Response Ready Api V1 Ready Get

503.description: One or more dependencies are unreachable.

get.description:
Issue a standalone CSRF token for pre-authentication flows.

Use the returned token in the `X-CSRF-Token` header when calling the login
and entry endpoints from a browser form. After authentication, prefer the
session-bound token returned by `GET /auth/me`.

200.description: A short-lived CSRF token for unauthenticated flows.

post.description:
Authenticate an examiner with username and password.

On success an HttpOnly `session_id` cookie (1 hour TTL) is set on the
response. After 5 failed attempts within 15 minutes the account is
temporarily locked (423) and `locked_until` indicates when it reopens.

200.description: Examiner profile; the session cookie is set on the response.

400.description: Validation error — one or more request fields are invalid.

post.description:
Register a new examinee or resume an in-progress test session.

Identified by PRN (registration number) and name; privacy acknowledgement
is mandatory. Returns **201** when a new account and session are created,
**200** when an existing in-progress session is resumed. An HttpOnly
`session_id` cookie (4 hour TTL) is set on the response. Registration is
rate-limited per IP (429).

200.description: The active test session for the examinee (existing session resumed).

201.description: A new examinee account and test session were created.

400.description: Validation error — one or more request fields are invalid.

example.title: Validation Error
example.detail: One or more fields failed validation.

errors.message: String should have at least 1 character

403.description: Identity mismatch — the PRN exists but the name does not match.

example.title: Identity Mismatch
example.detail: The provided details do not match our records.

409.description: This registration number has already completed the test (retakes disabled).

example.title: Exam Already Completed
example.detail: This registration number has already completed the test.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — retry after the indicated delay.

example.title: Rate Limit Exceeded
example.detail: Too many requests. Please try again later.

example.detail: The question bank does not have enough active questions.

post.description:
Submit the test session for scoring. This action is irreversible.

The request body must include `confirm: true`. Requires the
`X-CSRF-Token` header. Pass an `Idempotency-Key` header to make retries
safe — duplicate submissions with the same key return the original score.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Optional client-generated key making the submission retry-safe: repeated submits with the same key return the original result instead of failing.
